card.name: The word after "one or"
card.fires_on: The word right after "one or" or "one or the", such as other, both, another or two. Also seen after "once" in "once a week".

modes.label: One or both/other
modes.description: Completes the phrase "one or ..." with other, both or another, referring to a pair of items.
modes.example: If one or<< both>> tablets of risedronate sodium

modes.label: Approximate amount or frequency
modes.description: A small word completing a rough quantity or frequency phrase.
modes.example: The artillery was advanced a rod or<< two>> in front of the line

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning "that's enough" or "just" and promotes words meaning "this time" or "a new round", with no clear fit.
card.plain: It fires on the closing word of phrases like "one or both" or "one or the other".
